    Card images load from Bulbagarden Archives; card lists from Bulbapedia. Release dates and TCGplayer market prices come from tcgcsv.com's daily copy of TCGplayer data (Japanese cards use TCGplayer's Pokémon Japan listings). Cardmarket prices are 30-day average sell prices from Cardmarket's public price guide, linked to cards through TCGdex; Cardmarket doesn't price 1st Edition separately, and its reverse holo price is its "holo" price field. Price snapshot 19 Oct 2026; €1 = $1.1253 (ECB). Near Mint prices are market data; LP, MP, HP and DMG are estimated at 85%, 70%, 50% and 30% of Near Mint. English and Japanese releases only.     Scan a binder page

    Take a photo of a binder page, straight on and with as little glare as possible. Drag the four corner dots onto the corners of the card area, pick the page layout, and the app finds which artworks are in each pocket. You check the results before anything is marked as collected.
